description: Run a listing with input that matches its input_schema. Reserves the quoted maximum, bills only valid results and refunds the rest. With wait=true (default) it returns results, or a run id with a next_action when the run is still going. Invalid input returns field errors and reserves nothing. Errors carry stable codes such as listing_not_found, listing_degraded, spend_cap_exceeded and blocked_upstream (refunded). Needs an API key with the scrape scope; use alterlab_store_quote first to see the cost.

wait.description: Wait for results (default true); false returns a run id immediately

name: alterlab_store_run
title: Run Data Store Listing
